I posted a reply in #strategic-random. I did not set up the 07:45 brief.

I can't schedule a standing post into these channels. The scheduled jobs I can create run locally and don't deliver into Slack, so nothing would appear on its own. I offered to post a brief by hand when you ask it, and asked if you want today's now. Briefs will leave out money terms, since #strategic-random doesn't include the finance audience, and will cover only what everyone in that channel can see in the source channels.
